premises.text: Bicycle theft is a large costly problem and existing keyless locks and trackers are not integrated into one smart lock
premises.evidence_span: bike security tech today is not that advanced. There are some keyless locks, and then there are some tracking devices. But they haven't been integrated really

premises.text: Lock8 integrates alarm, physical security, GPS tracking, and keyless unlocking in one device
premises.evidence_span: It has to have an alarm. It has to be secure. And it has to be GPS trackable

premises.text: Multi-sensor tamper detection (vibration, gyroscope, temperature, light, hot-wired cable) triggers alarms and push notifications
premises.evidence_span: the sensors inside Lock8 are truly advanced

premises.text: App locates the lock, adjusts sensitivity, and delivers notifications by push, email, or SMS
premises.evidence_span: I can locate myself I can locate my lock where my lock is

premises.text: Owners can share or rent bikes/locks via the connected device without needing city bike-share infrastructure
premises.evidence_span: we can share bikes easily with anyone that we want

domains.name: integrated smart lock security and tracking
bike sharing and rental via lock

value.text: Bikes stay safer while owners can share or monetize them through connected mobility
value.evidence_span: you can rent your bike out to whoever you want, and you can rest assured that your bike will be safe

causal_links.evidence_span: if your bicycle actually gets stolen, we have a tracker, a GPS tracker
truly disrupt what bicycle sharing is all about

notes: Required smart-lock attributes (alarm, secure, GPS, keyless) kept as one integrated product premise; sensor list folded as feature cascade of tamper detection (v1.5.1 §4.1.7). Sharing/rental split as separately revisable connected-mobility path. Demo glitches noted but pitch not truncated.
